steps: Open / in a fresh browser context with empty sessionStorage and LLM_PROVIDER=mock.
Confirm the prompt form has no radio named model-access.
Fill the prompt and click 开始生成 without opening 设置.
expect: The app navigates to /projects/… and the workbench title is visible.
The create request carried no x-atoms-byok-key header.

steps: Open / and click the 设置 control above the title.
Read the dialog titled 模型设置, including both choices and the product paragraph.
Close it with Escape.
expect: The URL stays /.
Both 平台演示 and 使用我的 API Key are inside the dialog.
After Escape the radios are gone and focus returns to 设置.

steps: Open 设置, choose 使用我的 API Key, leave the key empty, and close the dialog.
Enter a prompt and click 开始生成.
expect: The URL stays /.
An alert asks for a complete API key and a button named 打开设置 is visible.
No POST /api/projects is sent and no model-access radio is visible on the form.

steps: Open / and open 设置.
Read the visible text of the prompt form and of the dialog.
expect: Neither surface contains 清除 Cookie, 重置 Cookie, 设备号, x-atoms-byok, or D1.
With the dialog closed, the prompt form does not contain 模型来源.

steps: Open 设置, choose 使用我的 API Key, enter a 513-character key with no spaces, and close the dialog.
Reload and inspect sessionStorage.
Switch back to 平台演示, enter a 1000-character prompt, and inspect the form.
expect: atoms.byok.session is null after the oversized key.
开始生成 becomes enabled for the 1000-character prompt.
The prompt form still has no model-access radios.

steps: On a fresh platform-demo session, generate from / without opening 设置.
On the workbench, inspect the follow-up form and click the header 设置 control.
expect: The follow-up form has no API Key field and no model-access radio.
The header dialog shows 平台演示 selected, the same panel as on the home page.

steps: Open 设置, choose 使用我的 API Key, enter abcd1234efgh5678, and close the dialog.
Reload, open 设置, and read the key field.
Choose 平台演示, reload, and open 设置 again.
expect: After the first reload the mode is byok and the key field still holds abcd1234efgh5678.
After choosing 平台演示 and reloading, the mode is platform and atoms.byok.session is null.
localStorage does not contain the key.

steps: Open / at 1280×800 with an empty prompt.
Observe the empty hint and the disabled 开始生成 control.
Open 设置, press Escape, then repeat the open and close at 375×812.
expect: The empty state still shows 请先输入应用需求，或点击下方示例卡片快速填入.
设置 does not overlap the title, and the closed form has no radios.
At 375×812 the dialog's close control is visible and the panel scrolls instead of clipping the choices.
